status: Experimental bounded continuation recovers a smaller construction candidate. Not an accepted or fully qualified board; current fallback ceilings would be exceeded.

mechanism.configuration: FloorplanPoseRetryLimits.continuations defaults to zero; profiler --reseat-continuations N requires both pose limits, compact mode and an explicit interior order. Conflicts with failed-first restart are rejected.
mechanism.policy: After a full attempt fails downstream of a selected alternative-pose recovery, restore entry state and replay with the next locally feasible choice at the first recovery. Preserve every ordinary/complete successful incumbent. Stop at success, no selectable first recovery, or the explicit continuation cap. Later recovery decisions still use their first feasible choice; this is bounded first-decision reconsideration, not exhaustive backtracking.
mechanism.accounting: Record interior_reseat_pose_resume before each actual full-attempt replay and interior_reseat_pose_skip for each locally feasible branch exclusion. Retain every executed precision operation, budget event and failed legalizer attempt. Observer skipped counts distinguish exclusions from geometric rejection.
mechanism.bounds: At most continuations additional complete attempts per explicitly ordered attempt_pack invocation. Each inner position query retains its pose/frontier bounds. No wall-time guarantee; repeated outer sizing/refinement calls each have their own cap.
mechanism.transaction: Restore original layout, side offers and order on terminal failure or exception, preserving executed accounting. No shared cache, global state or changed hard-constraint thresholds.

tests.independent_replay: 29 finite fixture cases plus 29 late-failure variants, each at three orders. Compare the wrapper against independently executed skip-0 through skip-3 attempts: actual instrumented scalar entries, full quantization receipts, ordered fallback events, selected layout and side offers or entry rollback. Nine replay events and eighteen skipped local choices exercised; synthetic replay rescues zero complete plans, while the earlier pose-recovery fixtures retain three successes.
tests.late_failure: Adversarial terminal block has small nominal ordering dimensions and four physically oversized candidate shapes. It forces downstream failure after local recovery; no oversized candidate is accepted.
tests.exception: Throw from an observer after a skipped local choice during the second actual attempt. Verify immediate abort, restored layout/offers, two actual scalar entries and exactly one retained replay event.
tests.invalid_policies: Reject continuation without explicit order or combined with failed-first retry. Independently enumerate both new fallback declarations.

carrier_screen.timing_limitations: Construction-only diagnostics, observers enabled, OS caches uncontrolled, with other validation activity. Not isolated performance measurements, compile/render/audit timings, a same-layout speed comparison or a Python comparison.
